You are making a surgical, additive edit to ONE Python file for an SMS booking gateway resolver. A first attempt was too greedy (it stripped ordinals off relative counts like "in 2nd days", producing wrong dates) and lacked a tenant guard. This is the corrected, tighter version. BOUNDARY: write only inside your task directory. You own exactly two output files: ./bland_gateway.py and ./report.md. Do NOT touch any other file, do NOT git commit, do NOT run the gateway, do NOT call any network/API/MCP, do NOT load skills.

STEP 1. Copy /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mott-date-arch/impl-src/bland_gateway.py to ./bland_gateway.py. It is a 2116-line file. You will make THREE additive insertions and change NOTHING else. Do not delete or modify any existing line. Every change is a pure insertion.

CONTEXT. resolve_relative_date is exact-match, branch by branch, and returns None for anything it does not recognize, including "july 28th" (ordinal suffix). We add a narrow, month-anchored ordinal fallback that runs ONLY after every existing branch has failed (only at the final return None), ONLY for Mott (not the shared CVC tenant), and ONLY for a well-formed month + valid-ordinal day (+ optional year). It re-resolves through the existing grammar, so it cannot invent anything the existing code would not accept.

INSERTION 1 - the flag. Find the line CONSUMER_ACCEPT_LEGACY = _env_bool("ECP_CONSUMER_ACCEPT_LEGACY", True) (near line 158; there is a helper def _env_bool(name, default) just above it). Immediately AFTER that line insert exactly:
    _DATE_ORDINAL_FALLBACK = _env_bool("ECP_DATE_ORDINAL_FALLBACK", False)

INSERTION 2 - the month list and suffix helper. Immediately ABOVE the line def resolve_relative_date(raw) -> str | None: insert exactly these module-level definitions (keep a blank line before def resolve_relative_date):
    _ORDINAL_MONTHS = (
        "january|february|march|april|may|june|july|august|september|"
        "october|november|december|jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec"
    )


    def _ordinal_suffix(day: int) -> str:
        if 11 <= day % 100 <= 13:
            return "th"
        return {1: "st", 2: "nd", 3: "rd"}.get(day % 10, "th")

INSERTION 3 - the fallback, inserted BEFORE the existing final return None of resolve_relative_date. That final return None is the LAST line of the function, immediately after the loop for fmt in ("%m/%d", "%B %d", "%b %d"): and its body (around line 603). Leave that existing return None line exactly where it is; insert ABOVE it:
    if _DATE_ORDINAL_FALLBACK and TENANT_ID != "cvc":
        m = re.fullmatch(r"(" + _ORDINAL_MONTHS + r") (\d{1,2})(st|nd|rd|th)( \d{4})?", t)
        if m and 1 <= int(m.group(2)) <= 31 and m.group(3) == _ordinal_suffix(int(m.group(2))):
            return resolve_relative_date(f"{m.group(1)} {m.group(2)}{m.group(4) or ''}")

Notes: `t` is the already lowercased, punctuation-stripped, whitespace-collapsed string built at the top of the function. `re` and `TENANT_ID` are already available at module scope (TENANT_ID is defined near line 52). The re-resolve call re-enters resolve_relative_date with an ordinal-free string, so it takes an existing branch and cannot recurse into this block again.

WHY THIS IS SAFE (do not deviate):
- It only ever runs at the FINAL return None, so no phrase the resolver already handles can change (legacy-first).
- re.fullmatch anchored to a month name means a bare ordinal ("28th"), an ordinal on a relative count ("in 2nd days", "28th days from now", "2nd weeks from now"), or a bare weekday ("the 2nd tuesday") never matches, so they stay None.
- The _ordinal_suffix equality check rejects a malformed suffix, so "july 11st", "july 22th", "july 23nd" stay None.
- TENANT_ID != "cvc" means even if the flag is turned on in a CVC process, the fallback is inert, so CVC behavior is unchanged.
- It is additions only: you delete/modify nothing, so the entire existing resolver (all inputs, English and Chinese) is preserved.

VERIFY - run this yourself; it is exactly how you are graded:
    python3 /mnt/d_drive/repos/mott/gw-temporal-check/check_gateway_datefix.py --original /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mott-date-arch/impl-src/bland_gateway.py --candidate ./bland_gateway.py
It must print CHECK PASSED and exit 0. It proves, at a frozen Monday 2026-07-27: flag off is byte-identical to the original across the whole corpus; flag on changes zero legacy phrases; the new month-day ordinal phrases resolve (july 28th -> 07/28/2026, november 22nd -> 11/22/2026, etc.); the over-broad and malformed inputs stay None; with the flag on but TENANT_ID=cvc everything is still the original (tenant guard); and the source diff is additions only.

OUTPUT CONTRACT for ./report.md: start with "# Gateway Ordinal Fix v2", then "## Summary" (max 3 bullets), "## The Diff" (show ONLY your three inserted blocks), "## Verify" (paste the exact CHECK PASSED line), "## Additive Proof" (state that a diff against the original shows only insertions, no deletions). Under 450 words.
